title: HouseOperations + SkyeBox

surfaces.role: Gate ID + PIN + recovery code lane

boundaries: SkyeBox authenticator secrets remain local to the browser vault.
FS27 PIN/recovery controls unlock the gate session, not a managed TOTP custody service.
Recovery email delivery requires AUTH_EMAIL_WEBHOOK_URL; without it, the gate runs preview mode.
proof_requirements: PIN setup stores only hashed PIN material.
Recovery codes are hashed and one-time consumed.
HouseOperations gate mirror packets are exported or posted only when a real FS27 event mirror secret exists.
Browser proof must show HouseOperations task/vendor/proof/export flow and SkyeBox vault/TOTP/export flow.
